result.summary: A residential street with sidewalks on both sides but lacking marked pedestrian crossings and ADA-compliant infrastructure. The roadway pavement is significantly degraded, and parked vehicles may obstruct sightlines at potential crossing points.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at corners to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility by preventing parking too close to the intersection.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps for accessibility.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is significantly underdeveloped, lacking marked crosswalks and featuring a fragmented, poorly maintained sidewalk network. The wide roadway and residential context suggest a high risk for pedestrians due to a lack of dedicated infrastructure and potential for higher vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Missing Crosswalks
hazards.description: The absence of marked crossing points at the intersection increases pedestrian exposure and unpredictability for drivers.

hazards.name: Degraded Sidewalk Infrastructure
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the left is narrow and overgrown, while the right side appears to lack a paved walkway entirely, forcing pedestrians into the roadway.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb block the visibility of pedestrians attempting to cross the street.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Installation
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way at the intersection.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction and Expansion
interventions.description: Construct continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide safe separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the intersection to improve sightlines between pedestrians and motorists.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection that lacks fundamental pedestrian safety infrastructure, including marked crosswalks and curb ramps. While the street appears to be a low-volume residential road, the presence of visual obstructions from hedges and parked cars, combined with poor pavement quality, creates a hostile environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this intersection, providing no designated space for pedestrians to cross.

hazards.name: Missing Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The lack of curb ramps creates a significant barrier for individuals with mobility impairments or those using strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: At the corners of the intersection

hazards.name: Sightline Obstructions
hazards.description: Tall hedges and parked vehicles near the corner obstruct the view between pedestrians and approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracking and uneven asphalt surfaces present potential trip hazards.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: ADA-Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Construct curb ramps with tactile warning strips at all four corners of the intersection.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection and trim hedges to improve visibility for all users.

result.summary: This residential street lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and traffic calming measures. While a sidewalk exists on the right side, its condition is fair to poor, and the long, straight roadway geometry may encourage higher vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Poor sidewalk condition
hazards.description: The existing sidewalk on the right shows signs of cracking and unevenness, which can be a trip hazard.
